namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
open scoped BigOperators

theorem study_d_prime_factorial (p n : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) : p ∣ n.factorial ↔ p ≤ n
:= by
  split
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨k, hk, hk'⟩ := h
    have : p ≤ n := by
      have : k ≤ n := by
        rw [hk]
        exact le_of_not_gt (λ hkn, hkn (nat.succ_le_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_ne (le_refl n) hk)))
      exact le_of_exists (λ i, by
        cases i with
        | zero =>
          have : n.factorial = 0 := by
            rw [factorial_zero]
            exact hk'
          contradiction
        | succ i =>
          have : p ∣ (i + 1) := by
            rw [factorial_succ]
            exact h
          obtain ⟨j, hj, hj'⟩ := this
          exact le_of_exists (λ i, by
            have : (i + 1) * (i + 1) = (i + 1) * (i + 1) := by
              rw [mul_comm, mul_one]
            have : (i + 1) * (i + 1) = (i + 1) * (i + 1) := by
              rw [hj']
            exact hj'
          )
      )
  · intro h
    have : p ≤ n := h
    exact le_of_exists (λ i, by
      cases i with
      | zero =>
        have : n.factorial = 0 := by
          rw [factorial_zero]
          exact h
        contradiction
      | succ i =>
        have : p ∣ (i + 1) := by
          rw [factorial_succ]
          exact h
        obtain ⟨j, hj, hj'⟩ := this
        exact le_of_exists (λ i, by
          have : (i + 1) * (i + 1) = (i + 1) * (i + 1) := by
            rw [mul_comm, mul_one]
          have : (i + 1) * (i + 1) = (i + 1) * (i + 1) := by
            rw [hj']
          exact hj'
        )
    )
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : Nl2LeanExpected.study_d_prime_factorial = Nl2LeanCandidate.study_d_prime_factorial := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
